festivals.name: Deepavali
festivals.blurb: Crackers, sweets, sarees & malls near you

tips.d: Shop at licensed dealers and look for the green cracker mark.
Tamil Nadu announces cracker timings before Deepavali. Watch the News tab.
Wear cotton clothes and keep children supervised.
T. Nagar and Purasawalkam are packed in the last week. Try weekday mornings or take the Metro.

festivals.name: Karthigai Deepam
festivals.blurb: Lamps, sweets and the Maha Deepam

tips.d: Keep diyas away from curtains and dry leaves, and never leave them unattended.
Lakhs travel for the evening lighting. Book buses and trains early.
San Thome Basilica fills up early on Christmas Eve. Arrive well ahead.
Bakeries get busy in the last week of December.

festivals.name: Pongal
festivals.blurb: New clothes, sweets and Kaanum Pongal outings

tips.d: Marina and Elliot's Beach get very crowded. Go early and keep children close.
Special buses run from Kilambakkam and Koyambedu. Book early.
